essence: In this context, the prescribed rite requires an oblation of eight thousand offerings.
The solar mantra is declared as a three-syllabled formula composed with bhṛgu and the creation element.
The practitioner should perform the placement of the seer and associated preliminaries.
The three seed syllables should be placed in order from the head down to the throat.
The formation of the limbs and related parts is to be done with the middle seed syllable joined with the six long vowels.
